analysis.title: North American Precious Metals Weekly: Q3'26 precious metals results have been challenging. Still more results this week
key_insights: Q3'26 reporting so far has been unkind to share prices: 5 of 6 reporters underperformed the S&P/TSX Global Gold Index one day after results despite mostly OK results. Weak gold price did not help. Most cited emerging cost pressures (diesel, consumables, drilling, parts) but said they can partly mitigate them.
Eight more companies report this week: four precious metal producers, three royalty and streaming companies and one primary silver producer.

Gold averaged $4,263/oz in Q3'26, down 5.4% QoQ and up 23.3% YoY. Silver averaged $62.71/oz, down 14.3% QoQ. BofA covered precious metals names are forecast to generate about $6.1bn of FCF in Q3'26E and $29.2bn in 2026E.

BofA expects companies that surprise up on capital return while still investing in growth and meeting or beating guidance to perform best after Q3'26 results. Early 2027 outlooks (production, cost, reserves) are a focus.

Gold fell 3.0% on the week to $3,874.62/oz. The Fed held rates on Oct 28 and left open a possible rate hike before year-end. On Friday Oct 30 gold dropped from $4,042 to $3,875 as rising oil prices fed inflation concerns and a global tech selloff led investors to liquidate bullion to cover losses elsewhere.
Silver fell 8.9% on the week, platinum 7.6% and palladium 6.5%. XAU, HUI and S&P/TSX Global Gold fell 3.9%, 3.9% and 4.1%.

Agnico Eagle (AEM) Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA of $2.74bn beat BofAe and consensus. Capital return was $455m, about 53% of FCF, and management called a 50% payout (vs 40% before) a reasonable 2027 estimate. BofA models 2026E gold output of 3.31Moz, at the low end of 3.30-3.50Moz guidance, and 2026E total cash costs of $1,114/oz, at the high end of guidance. 2026E EPS raised to $11.04 from $10.89. PO unchanged at $233/C$331. AEM is BofA's 2026 top precious metals pick. Buy reiterated.

Alamos Gold (AGI) Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA was 5% below BofAe on 3% lower gold sales and 4% higher costs. EPS was in line. The Phase 3+ shaft was delayed one quarter, capex rose 5%, and PDA H2'27 production is expected below plan, adding downside risk to 2027/28 guidance. 2027E production cut to 608koz from 656koz and 2027E EPS cut 9% to $2.64. PO lowered to $34/C$48 from $36/C$51. Neutral reiterated pending February 2027 guidance.

Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF) Q4'26 adjusted EBITDA guide of $715m is below BofA's prior $793m. 2027 EBITDA potential is about $4.5bn assuming spot pricing holds. PO raised to $15 from $14. Neutral reiterated.

Kinross (KGC) Q3'26 EBITDA was in line with BofAe but 2-4% below consensus. It is on track for 2026 guidance of 1.84-1.86Moz GEO. BofA stays cautious because 2027 production is expected flat with higher cash costs while peers grow production and cut unit costs. 2026E EPS raised to $2.39 from $2.32. Underperform reiterated.
Wheaton (WPM) 2026E EPS cut to $4.36 from $4.52 as operators reported. BofA likes its peer-leading long-term attributable production growth, long reserve life and asset portfolio. Buy reiterated.

Share price reactions one day after Q3'26 results, relative to the S&P/TSX Global Gold Index: Centerra YCG +4.1%, AEM -1.1%, NEM -2.3%, KGC -3.2%, EGO -3.2%, AGI -6.1%. Eldorado missed EPS (-13% vs BofAe, +5% vs BBG as listed); the others beat.

Q3'26 operating estimates are generally weaker, with most producers seeing higher costs. BofAe Q3'26 total cash costs rose YoY at AEM (+14.0%), Barrick (+37.4%), KGC (+30.6%), NEM (+22.3%), AGI (+41.2%) and BTG (+61.1%). Diesel averaged $4.22/gal, up 15.0% QoQ and 85.6% YoY.

BofA's Q3'26 EPS estimates are above Bloomberg consensus for NEM ($2.20 vs $1.97), AEM ($2.62 vs $2.51), RGLD ($2.96 vs $2.74) and FNV ($1.90 vs $1.73), and below for Barrick ($0.70 vs $0.78) and Eldorado ($0.33 vs $0.59). BofA's 2026E EBITDA is about 3% below consensus for the gold producer group, with SSRM (+5% vs BBG) and EGO (+8%) higher.

This week's reporters: SSRM and TFPM (Nov 3), BTG, PAAS, RGLD (Nov 4 in the BofA table), AUGO, IAG, WPM, with focus on production guidance, costs, capital returns, M&A and deal pipelines. Barrick reports Nov 9 and Franco-Nevada Nov 11.

Valuation: North American precious metals stocks trade at 1.40x NAV (market-value weighted), within the 10-year 1.0-2.0x range. Royalty companies trade at 2.13x NAV (WPM 2.24x, FNV 2.12x, RGLD 2.06x), and gold producers only at 1.15x. Largest 2026E FCF yields skew to producers and royalty/streaming names.
BofA 2026E price deck: gold $4,389/oz, silver $68.45/oz, platinum $1,861/oz, palladium $1,406/oz, copper $6.02/lb.

sector_views.rationale: Share prices have reacted poorly to Q3 results as gold fell and costs rose, though sector FCF is robust. Companies that raise capital returns while meeting guidance should do best.
Trade at 2.13x NAV versus 1.15x for gold producers. BofA is Buy on WPM and TFPM, Neutral on FNV and Underperform on RGLD.

earnings_insights: AEM Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA $2.74bn, beat BofAe ($2,466mn) and Bloomberg/Visible Alpha consensus (reported 10/28 after close). EPS estimate table shows BofAe Q3'26E $2.62 vs BBG consensus $2.51, but the table is a pre-report estimate.
AGI Q3'26 adjusted EBITDA reported 5% below BofAe, EPS in line with BofAe. 2026E EPS now $2.12 and 2027E $2.64 (BofAe).
KGC Q3'26 reported EBITDA in line with BofAe and 2-4% below consensus. BofAe 2026E EPS $2.39.
CLF Q3'26 reported adjusted EBITDA above BofAe and consensus. Q4'26 adjusted EBITDA guidance $715m vs prior BofAe $793m.

Exhibit 3 EPS results vs estimates: NEM beat (BofAe +31%, BBG +25%), AEM beat (+1%, +3%), KGC beat (+29%, +24%), AGI beat (+6%, +5%), EGO miss (-13% vs BofAe, +5% vs BBG as printed), YCG beat (+38%, +19%).

Pre-report BofAe Q3'26E (estimates, not prints): FNV EPS $1.90 vs BBG consensus $1.73; RGLD $2.96 vs $2.74; WPM $0.90 vs $0.91; PAAS $0.68 vs $0.66; SSRM $0.65 vs $0.64; AUGO $1.45 vs $1.45; IAG $0.38 vs $0.40; BTG $0.14 vs $0.12; Barrick $0.70 vs $0.78 (reports 11/9).
Triple Flag pre-released Q3'26 GEO sales of 25,030 (actual) and YTD sales of 83,870. A Q4 of 23,630 would put 2026 sales between the mid-point and high end of the 100,000-110,000 GEO guidance.

Upcoming report dates per BofA: SSRM and TFPM 11/3, IAG 11/4 (exhibit 7) or 11/5 (exhibit 18), BTG, WPM, PAAS, RGLD, AUGO and FNV in the 11/4-11/11 range, Barrick 11/9. The document's own dates are inconsistent across exhibits.

AEM modeled Q4'26 gold production 809koz and 2026 3.31Moz vs 3.30-3.50Moz guidance. KGC guidance 1.84-1.86Moz GEO. IAG 2026 guidance 720-820koz at AISC $2,000-2,150/oz. PAAS guidance 25-27Moz silver. WPM guidance 860-940k GEOs. RGLD guidance 290-320k oz gold. AUGO guidance 340-390k GEO.

macro_indicators.interpretation: The Fed reiterated its commitment to containing inflation and gave limited guidance, leaving open a rate hike before year-end. That weighed on gold.
Down from 2.64% the prior week. Real rates remain high versus the 52-week low of 1.67%, a headwind for gold.
Lower QoQ gold and silver prices weigh on Q3 earnings across coverage.
BofA 2026E average gold, versus $3,445 in 2025A and $3,874.62 spot on 10/30.
Fuel is a main driver of emerging cost pressure at miners.

trade_ideas.description: Overweight AEM as BofA's 2026 top precious metals pick
trade_ideas.rationale: Top-tier assets and jurisdictions, record of meeting or exceeding targets, growth projects and exploration upside.
trade_ideas.risk: Commodity price weakness, financing, operating problems and political risk.

trade_ideas.description: Own stocks that surprise up on capital return while meeting or beating guidance after Q3'26 results
trade_ideas.rationale: Sector FCF is robust, so capital allocation and shareholder returns are the focus.

risk_factors: Weaker gold price and Fed uncertainty, including a possible rate hike before year-end.
Cost inflation in diesel, consumables, drilling and parts, with 2027 cost guidance a risk.
Operational issues such as shaft delays at Alamos, Goose crushing repairs at B2Gold and the Q4-weighted production profiles at SSRM and AUGO.
El Nino production impacts in South America.
Rising oil prices and tech-selloff-driven liquidation of bullion.

tension_points.bull_case: Sector FCF is robust (about $6.1bn in Q3'26E) and companies that raise capital returns while meeting guidance should be rewarded. AEM's payout is rising to 50% from 40%.
tension_points.bear_case: Lower gold price, emerging cost pressures and operational delays drove 5 of 6 reporters to underperform the S&P/TSX Global Gold Index after results.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Results from this week's eight reporters showing capital returns or production guidance that fail to lift share prices would undercut the capital-return thesis. Alamos's February 2027 guidance is the named catalyst for its Neutral view.
